messages:
Liz: quick heads up — created a docs PR that updates the streaming/retry/pagination snippets across py/ts/go. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/428
Sam: taking a look. what's the behavioral change? do we preserve existing sync iterator semantics?
Liz: No behavior change; it's just clearer examples + added backpressure note for streaming iterators. main change: show `async for chunk in stream` + explain `await stream.aclose()` when aborting.
Sam: can you paste the short python snippet here so I can sanity-check?
Liz:
```py
async for chunk in client.responses.stream(...):
    process(chunk)
# if aborting early:
await client.responses.stream(...).aclose()
```
Prashant: I'll port the abort example to Go — there's no direct `aclose()` so we should show `stream.Close()` or context cancel. i'll open a small PR after this.
Eva: I'll run the docs linter and link checker once the PR is merged. also want to add a one-liner about exponential backoff jitter for retries.
Sam: small nit: update TS example to use `for await (const part of stream)` instead of the old callback pattern. less confusing.
Liz: noted. I'll push one more commit tonight. @Prashant let me know if you want me to draft the Go snippet.
Prashant: please do a draft — saves me time. i'll tweak for idiomatic go channels.
DocBot: CI started for PR #428 — docs-lint, linkcheck, snippets-verify
DocBot: docs-lint passed; linkcheck found 1 broken anchor (fixed in latest commit)
Liz: thanks! merging tomorrow if no other blockers. :ship:
